data: Which line is the highest for a False Alarm Probability of 10%?

The question asks which line corresponds to the highest Miss probability at a False Alarm Probability of 10%. From the caption, we know that the figure shows DET curves for monolingual and multilingual features estimated using FFNs and ResNets for T1 queries of QUESST 2014. The lines in the figure represent different feature combinations, with distinct colors and labels.

To determine which line is the highest at a False Alarm Probability of 10%, we need to look at the y-axis values (Miss probability) for each line when the x-axis value (False Alarm probability) is approximately 10%.

From the analysis of the figure:
- The line labeled "FFN: PT" appears to be the highest among all the lines at a False Alarm Probability of 10%.

Thus, the line corresponding to the highest Miss probability at a False Alarm Probability of 10% is the one labeled "FFN: PT".
